blocks.text: Thank you for the quick answers on the phone this morning. We now have the spokesperson names, and your confirmation that Kirby-Taylor pitches come to you alone for sign-off. I have set up our approvals that way.

To be exact about what is with you now: the backgrounder (v3), the fact sheet (v2), and the reporter list (v2). Each reflects the latest comments from your team. Nothing goes to a reporter until all three are approved.

If we can have your approval or your edits by Friday, outreach for {{fact:f:E-2022-001.client}} can begin the following week. Michael's preparation sessions would run alongside it, ahead of any interviews the outreach brings in.
